title: Representative read-only Archicad selection for the Partner Pilot
note: Synthetic model shaped like a partner selection. Contains no client data, no client model and no identifier. It deliberately mixes populated, empty and non-space elements so the metadata audit can be proven on all three cases instead of a uniformly empty selection.

selected_elements.comment: Populated usage, missing SIA surface type - carries the real before value of the dry run.
Inverse case: surface type known, usage missing.
Fully documented zone - must produce no finding (false-positive control).
Non-space element - must be excluded from the space metadata audit.
